findings.title: Chooser cancel not handled; empty path proposed
findings.message: If the user cancels the chooser, ChooseFile may return an empty path with nil error (or a cancel error). An empty path is then passed to ProposeFiles, producing a spurious rejection message, or a cancel error is shown as a failure.
findings.suggestion: After ChooseFile, treat an empty path with nil error as a cancel and skip ProposeFiles; also special-case the cancellation error.

findings.title: Bounded message can exceed bound after UTF-8 fixup
findings.message: Truncating at a byte boundary can split a multibyte rune. ToValidUTF8 then replaces the fragment with '?', which can grow the string; the result can slightly exceed 512 bytes (up to 2 extra). The test asserts len<=512 only for ASCII.
findings.suggestion: Sanitize with ToValidUTF8 first, then truncate at a rune boundary (e.g. back up while !utf8.RuneStart(s[n])).
